entries.zh: ADOFAI 编辑器优化 - 谱面渲染

entries.en: The game window size changed during rendering.
entries.zh: 渲染期间游戏窗口尺寸发生变化。

entries.en: The current game view size is invalid.
entries.zh: 当前游戏画面尺寸无效。

entries.en: Selected range rendering is available in the editor only.
entries.zh: 选中段落渲染只能在编辑器中使用。

entries.en: Select at least two continuous tiles first.
entries.zh: 请先框选至少两个连续砖块。

entries.en: Timed out while preparing the selected range.
Chart rendering is unavailable for this game version.
entries.zh: 当前游戏版本不可用谱面渲染。

entries.en: A video is still rendering. Cancel it in the settings page first, or close again within 10 seconds to quit anyway (the video will be lost).
entries.zh: 视频还在渲染。请先在设置页取消渲染；或在 10 秒内再次关闭以强制退出（视频将丢失）。

entries.en: All frames are rendered, but the video file is still being written. Please wait. Close again within 10 seconds to quit anyway (the video will be lost).
entries.zh: 画面已渲染完，但视频文件还在写入，请稍等。若在 10 秒内再次关闭将强制退出（视频将丢失）。
